title: Veyviz local video-analysis product
intentBasis: User request 2026-10-03: analyze latest worker/framework/Veyviz state and build an independent new full-stack modular, plugin-capable product using Quadbridge; original repositories remain preserved. Root adopts local recorded-video scope and proposed new target.

vision.destination: A usable modular local Product/UI plus separately owned AI/media implementation, proven by actual construction, inference, browser and restart.
users: Human owner inspecting direction and evidence
nonGoals: Claiming production/live-camera/native-device qualification from local checks
Inherited framework acceptance as product acceptance

policy.coreFirst: Finish the selected recorded-video product journey before speculative breadth.
nonNegotiables: Owner databases and authority remain separate.
Original repositories and framework source authority preserved.
Build before tests; failures/blocks/unrun gates remain visible.
policy.deferRule: Defer other profiles until concrete inputs and qualification are selected.

observations.summary: Independent source review accepted. Final suite completed with 378 passes, 0 failures and 1 skipped symlink fixture denied by Windows (EPERM). The release gate remains blocked.
limitations: No Windows security policy was weakened.
Source acceptance does not establish production, live camera, uploads or native device readiness.

retrospectives.problem: The native full regression began before desktop responsive review, requiring an additional broad run after UI repairs.
retrospectives.hypothesis: Completing cheap source-catalogue checks and browser breakpoint/role review before the broad freeze reduces repeated expensive checks.
retrospectives.action: Use source validation, installed smoke checks and real UI/role review before the final frozen broad regression. Keep all failed/blocked attempts.
retrospectives.measure: Track broad reruns caused by post-freeze fixes; no statistical sigma estimate is claimed from this single build.
